statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while weekend energy and geopolitical uncertainty keep Stress high.
recommendation: The current state is descriptive: low Tail, high Stress, and no live NQ price path while futures are closed.
headline: Closed-market Tail remains low; energy-supply risk keeps Stress high
body: NQ futures are closed for the weekend, so there is no live evidence of persistent one-way structure, shallow pullbacks, or failed retracements. Friday ended with substantial two-way trading. A fresh Saudi pipeline-related supply disruption raises reopening-gap and inflation uncertainty, supporting high Stress without establishing a higher Tail state.
